_notes: Compiled by HorsePin
current_player/current_ball from the joint pair test -- one hit across a full four-player game --
and independently confirmed by the exit dump, which reads player 4 / ball 3.
player_count at 0x02110900, the one address every Stern SAM game shares.
The map's existing score addresses were reproduced by the sweep and verified against the dump:
3,360,170 / 1,651,680 / 2,391,870 / 2,237,460, matching the machine's own game-over display.
The rejected CPU RAM candidate at 0x00031544 is the classic scaled-set false positive this
platform produces -- 732,790 / 184,370 / 18,320 / 11,450, each roughly a quarter of the one
before. Scores live in NVRAM on every SAM game measured, which is what rejects it.
game_over, tilted, credits and volume come from a 419-frame recording of live memory spanning
an operator-menu session and one four-ball game with a mid-ball tilt on ball 1. The menu session
also promoted ball_count and max_credits from derived to measured: Balls Per Game 5 -> 4 landed
at adjustment index 30 and Max Credits 9 -> 10 at index 32, as the free_play-relative rule
predicted.
0x0003246A is the status bitfield SAM games keep at ball+0x31: 1 in attract, 40 for the first
seconds of a game, 19 in play, 21 for exactly the 24 samples between the tilt and the end of
the tilted ball, during which player 1's score sat frozen at 53,210. 40 and 19 share no bit,
so game_over is 'any bit above 0x01' -- mask 0xFE inverted -- correct in all 419 frames.
tilted is bit 0x04, which no non-tilt value carries on this game.
volume at 0x02110250, set from 58 to 60 in the operator menu with its complement check byte
following; declared as checksum8. credits at 0x0211100C, the eighteenth SAM game at that
address, stepping down once at game start.
Best Combo Champion keeps a one-byte count at +0x1A, not a score at +24. Its record holds
01 00 05 00 at +24, which read as a 4-byte score gives 327,681; Spider-Man VE stores the same
field the same way and is declared as a one-byte counter at +0x1A, which reads 5. Corrected to
match. The plain Combo Champion at +24 is a genuine 4-byte count and is unchanged.
NVRAM also holds five valid champion records at 0x02102D28 on 32-byte centres, carrying Stern's
generic factory names (G S, L R, J R, D T, P P) against 75,000,000 down to 25,000,000. They are
deliberately not mapped: none of those initials appears in this game's attract, which shows only
the Autobot and Decepticon tables declared above. The records look like the generic high-score
table the ROM carries but does not use on this theme.
2026-11: tilted is the value 0x15 (mask 0x1F) on 0x0003246A: bit 0x04 is set in 5D/65/69, mode
values a headless game read.
2026-11: The A.1 (64) and A.2 (34) adjustments added from the ROM image (README, 'Adjustments
from the ROM').
Confirmed on a cabinet 2026-11-13 (ALP4K; two players, tilt on P1 ball 1): 2,470,730 /
1,341,010, the records and the status byte matched the DMD (28 at each ball served).
